draftPreview.heading: Xem truoc ban nhap truc tiep
draftPreview.title: Dot bien ngoai muc tieu cua CRISPR-Cas9: Su tien hoa cua phuong phap
paragraphs: Do chinh xac cua nuclease CRISPR-Cas9 duoc quyet dinh boi guide RNA, tuy nhien cat ngoai muc tieu van la tro ngai lon cho viec chuyen dich lam sang. Cac mo hinh du doan ban dau dua rat nhieu vao in silico, nhung thuong khong phan anh duoc dong hoc chromatin theo tung loai te bao.
draftPreview.composing: Agent dang tong hop phan nay dua tren phan tich so sanh giua cac phuong phap phat hien...

workflow.heading: Cach nghien cuu dang chay di qua dashboard

steps.title: Phan loai
steps.description: Truy van moi duoc xep uu tien theo muc do khan, do sau bang chung, va cac xung dot chua giai quyet de he thong cap phat bang thong truy xuat hop ly.

steps.title: Xac minh
steps.description: Moi goi nguon duoc kiem tra voi kho luu tru to chuc va corpora binh duyet truoc khi cac khang dinh duoc dua len lop tong hop.

steps.title: Ban giao
steps.description: Khi chat luong tin hieu dat nguong, ket qua duoc ket xuat thanh bao cao co the xuat ban, kem lien ket truy vet den bang chung goc.

workflow.quote: "Dashboard mang lai mot be mat nghien cuu duy nhat noi toc do truy xuat va do chat che bang chung co the cung ton tai."
workflow.author: — Truong van hanh nghien cuu, chuong trinh pilot ScholarAI

loginPage.heroHeading: Nghien cuu tu dong cho truy van phuc tap
loginPage.heroDescription: ScholarAI bien cac truy van tinh thanh hanh trinh nghien cuu dong. He thong agent lap ke hoach nhieu buoc, thuc thi tim kiem song song tren cac co so du lieu da xac minh, va tong hop ket qua thanh bao cao co cau truc do chinh xac cao.

form.heading: Bat dau truy van

featureGrid.heading: Quy trinh duoc ky thuat hoa chinh xac

multiStepPlanning.title: Lap ke hoach nhieu buoc
multiStepPlanning.description: Agent tach truy van phuc tap thanh cac tac vu logic, xac dinh khoang trong tri thuc va cac cum tu tien de truoc khi bat dau truy xuat du lieu.

sourceValidation.title: Xac minh nguon

parallelSearch.title: Tim kiem song song
parallelSearch.description: Truy xuat bat dong bo tren nhieu node giup nghien cuu day du va hoan thanh trong vai giay thay vi hang gio.

structuredReports.title: Bao cao co cau truc
structuredReports.description: Xuat ra LaTeX, Markdown, va PDF. Trich dan duoc dinh dang tu dong theo APA, MLA, hoac Chicago, kem lien ket DOI.

methodology.heading: Vong lap nghien cuu agentic

steps.title: Phan ra
steps.description: He thong phan tich y dinh cot loi cua truy van. No khong chi tim theo tu khoa ma con lap ban do canh quan tri thuc, xac dinh tranh luan chinh, bai bao nen tang, va xu huong moi can duoc xem xet.

steps.title: Truy xuat chu dong
steps.description: Su dung API bao mat va ky thuat web crawling nang cao, ScholarAI truy cap dong thoi cac co so du lieu hoc thuat cong khai va doc quyen. He thong danh gia do tin cay cua nguon ngay trong luong xu ly.

steps.title: Tong hop bien chung
steps.description: Cuoi cung, he thong hoa giai cac diem du lieu mau thuan. No lam ro diem dong thuan va khac biet, tao ra ban tong hop co sac thai va co trich dan noi tuyen.

methodology.quote: "ScholarAI da rut ngan chu ky tong quan tai lieu tu ba tuan xuong duoi bon muoi lam phut ma van giu do sau phan tich."
methodology.author: — TS. Elena Sterling, Vien Nghien cuu Cap cao

finalCta.heading: San sang mo rong bien do tri tue cua ban?
finalCta.description: Tham gia cung hon 50,000 nha nghien cuu dang dung ScholarAI de tang toc kham pha va giam tong hop thu cong.
finalCta.primary: Bat dau truy van dau tien
